Shanghai address as c/o Mrs. H.M. BUCHAN, 27 The Bund. This
lady is the individual's mother but she has not resided at
this address for over two years.

雷金纳德·斯图尔特·布坎（Reginald Stuart BUCHAN），英国籍，系档案 D. 6384 之当事人，于1937年6月11日乘“沙恩霍斯特”号轮船（s.s. "Scharnhorst"）从马尼拉返回上海。他持有1934年7月7日在上海签发的第10921号英国护照。
在外侨申报表中，此人将其在上海的地址列为：外滩27号，H.M. 布坎夫人（Mrs. H.M. BUCHAN）转交。该女士系此人之母，但她已不在此地址居住超过两年。

Changes Made
In Levy Staff

Buchan, Cook, Heuser,
Dunbar Shifting
To South

Several additions in the staff of
S. E. Levy & Co., investment
bankers and brokers, were an-
nounced today.
Mr. R. Buchan, who has been
prominent in local exchange cir-
cles for many years, became a
partner several months ago and
is at present in Manila where the
firm has established a branch
office.

came to the Orient with the Asia

been appointed managing partner
of the Manila office. Mr. Cook has
resided almost continuously in
Manila for the last 15 years where
he was engaged, in the invest-
ment and banking business. He
was foreign manager of the China

ly accountant of the National

numerous friends, including Soviet employees and agents,
who used the residence of the Buchan family as a place of
rendezvous.

Messrs. Burkhardt, Buchan & Co. (1934) Ltd. was,
in the spring of 1926, closely connected with the local
branch of the Soviet concern "EXPORTHLES". The firm in
question was known as "L.R. Burkhardt" until 1920 when
R.S. Buchan joined the company, which then assumed the
name of "Burkhardt, Buchan & Co." On April 28, 1934,
Mr. Burkhardt, a Swiss, and the principal partner, committed
suicide, and in November of the same year, the company was
liquidated. Towards the end of the year R. S. Buchan
and his brother W. M. Buchan, re-established the company
under the name of "Burkhardt, Buchan & Co. (1934) Ltd.,
with offices at Room 112, 2 Peking Road.

It was reported at this time that the Buchan brothers
possessed but a very limited capital, and that their firm
was in reality financed by Moscow in order to transact
certain business through the medium of a British firm on
occasions when it was not convenient for a Soviet concern
to act directly.

The significance of this arrangement was augmented
following the liquidation in 1935 of the local branch of
Centrosojus (England) Ltd. and the establishment, in its
stead, of a purely Soviet concern "EXPORTHLES."

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, TUESDAY, MAY 19, 1936

A FICTITIOUS
FILATURE

Troubles of a British Import
Firm

"Is that a common habit out here?"
asked Judge P. Grant Jones in H. M.
Supreme Court yesterday, when, in
the course of a judgment summons,
the debtor said that his firm had lost
a considerable amount of profit money
when a contract for a consignment of
silk was discovered to have been
made out to a fictitious Chinese
filature by a Chinese broker who had
subsequently disappeared. Mr. K. E.
Newman appeared for the judgment
creditor, Mr. J. N. Sipser, who obtained judgments for U.S. $5,000 and
U.S. $250 against Messrs. R. S. and
W. M. Buchan last year.
When the hearing opened, Judge P.
Grant Jones said that in future cases
of this nature, judgment would only
be given in Chinese standard dollars,
as in order to obtain execution of any
such judgments there had to be a
conversion of the foreign currency
into the local currency. Mr. Newman
agreed.
Examined by Mr. Newman, Mr. R.
S. Buchan said that the debt for U.S.
$5,000 was incurred in December, 1928,
when his brother acted as guarantor.
A year later, he joined Burkhardt,
Buchan & Co., which was then a
Swiss firm. He was paid no salary,
but received a commission, and was
given a present of $4,500 when he
married.

Little Business Done

The firm was later reorganized into
Burkhardt, Buchan & Co. (1934), Ltd.,
a British company, the directors of
which included his brother and his
sister. He was still employed by this
firm, which was connected with the
import and export trade, but
which did little business at the
moment. He admitted never having
paid any money back on the debt,
but said that Mr. Burkhardt had
formerly paid the interest on it, as
the loan had been secured for him
in the first place.
Witness admitted also that he had
made promises to pay, but said that
he had not been able to keep his
promises as two Chinese filatures had
repudiated their contracts, and the
firm lost some $12,000 in profits. One
of the filatures subsequently changed
its name, and the other was apparently fictitious. The Chinese brokers
could not be found.
An offer by both judgment debtors
to pay $200 down on both debts, and
to pay them off by instalments of
$100 a month was accepted by Mr.
Newman, and an order to that effect
was made by his Lordship.

《字林西报》，1936年5月19日，星期二

一家虚构的缫丝厂

一家英国进口商的困境

“这在本地是常见做法吗？”P. Grant Jones 法官昨日在英国最高法院审理一起判决传票案件时问道。当时，债务人在陈述中称，其商行因一名中国掮客将一批丝绸的合同开给了一家虚构的中国缫丝厂，而该掮客随后失踪，导致商行损失了巨额利润。K. E. Newman 先生代表判决债权人 J. N. Sipser 先生出庭。Sipser 先生曾于去年对 R. S. 和 W. M. Buchan 两位先生获得金额为5,000美元和250美元的判决。

庭审开始时，P. Grant Jones 法官表示，今后此类案件的判决将仅以中国标准银元作出，因为要执行任何此类判决，都必须将外币兑换为当地货币。Newman 先生表示同意。

经 Newman 先生讯问，R. S. Buchan 先生称，这笔5,000美元的债务产生于1928年12月，当时由其兄弟担任担保人。一年后，他加入了 Burkhardt, Buchan & Co.，这当时是一家瑞士商行。他没有领取薪水，而是收取佣金，并在结婚时获赠4,500美元。

生意寥寥

该商行后来重组为 Burkhardt, Buchan & Co. (1934), Ltd.，这是一家英国公司，董事包括他的兄弟和姐妹。他目前仍受雇于这家从事进出口贸易的商行，但该商行目前的业务量很少。他承认从未偿还过任何债务款项，但称 Burkhardt 先生以前曾代为支付利息，因为这笔贷款最初是为其担保的。

证人还承认他曾做出付款承诺，但称由于两家中国缫丝厂违约，他未能履行承诺，导致商行损失了约12,000美元的利润。其中一家缫丝厂后来更改了名称，另一家则显然是虚构的。那些中国掮客已无法找到。

两名判决债务人提出就两笔债务先各付200美元首付，其余部分每月分期偿还100美元，Newman 先生接受了这一提议，法官阁下据此作出了命令。

4 THE SHANGHAI TIMES, WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 29, 1933

PROMINENT BUSINESS
MAN FOUND DEAD

H. J. Burkhardt In Flat
With Bullet Wound
Through Heart

SUICIDE INDICATED;
LONG ILL-HEALTH

With a bullet wound through his heart, Mr. Henry James Burkhardt (54), well-known Shanghai business man and resident of many years' standing, was found dead in his flat in the Glen Line Building, Peking Road, early yesterday afternoon, in circumstances that point to suicide. He had suffered from heart trouble for some time.

Mr. Burkhardt was senior partner in the firm of Burkhardt, Buchan and Company, Ltd., merchants, of 19a-26a Canton Road. When he returned from the office to his flat, on the sixth floor at 2 Peking Road, for tiffin yesterday he appeared quite normal, and after the meal went to his bedroom for his customary rest.

At 2 p.m. his wife went to the room to call him and found him lying over the bed with a bullet through his heart. On the bed was a .25 calibre pistol containing one spent cartridge. Death had apparently been instantaneous. The fact that the sitting room is a long way from the bedroom accounts for the shot not being heard there.

Mr. Burkhardt is not known to have had any financial worries, but being a victim of heart trouble had been in ill health for some months. He was a Swiss citizen and officials from the Swiss Consulate-General visited the flat during the afternoon. Convinced that death was due to suicide, they decided not to hold an inquest.

Mr. Burkhardt had been in China some 33 years, and in addition to his place in the business world was very prominent and popular in local Swiss circles. He was a member of the Shanghai Club.

Mr. Burkhardt is survived by his widow, daughters and grandchildren. His widow is a sister of Mr. R. S. Buchan, his partner.

4 《上海泰晤士报》，1933年11月29日，星期三

知名商人
被发现身亡

H. J. 伯克哈特在公寓内
心脏中弹

疑似自杀；
长期健康不佳

亨利·詹姆斯·伯克哈特先生（Henry James Burkhardt，54岁），上海知名商人及资深居民，昨天下午早些时候被发现死于北京路格兰轮船公司大楼（Glen Line Building）的公寓内，心脏中弹，情况表明系自杀。他患心脏病已有一段时间。

伯克哈特先生是位于广东路19a-26a号的商号“伯克哈特、布坎有限公司”的高级合伙人。昨天他下班回到北京路2号六楼的公寓吃午饭时，看起来一切正常，饭后便去卧室进行例行的休息。

下午2点，他的妻子进房间叫他，发现他趴在床上，心脏中弹。床上有一把.25口径的手枪，里面有一枚已发射的弹壳。死亡显然是瞬间发生的。客厅离卧室较远，这解释了为何在那里没有听到枪声。

据知伯克哈特先生没有任何财务困扰，但因患有心脏病，过去几个月健康状况不佳。他是瑞士公民，瑞士总领事馆官员于当天下午走访了该公寓。由于确信死因是自杀，他们决定不进行验尸审讯。

伯克哈特先生在中国生活了约33年，除了在商界占有一席之地外，在当地瑞士人圈子中也非常显赫且受欢迎。他是上海总会会员。

伯克哈特先生遗孀、女儿及孙辈尚在。其遗孀是其合伙人R. S. 布坎先生的妹妹。

（手写批注：6 1/2）
